text: Ads for this game are total fake, which is not the major problem. The problem is that this game is not fun at all, the concept is nice, I like the idea of it, but it is so slow, if you need energy you have to play puzzles which is almost impossible without paying money, and no, not a little, you actually need to spend a lot of have more fun, for example production slots, otherwise you only can play it in very slow pace. It is not fun, expensive, and very slow. Puzzles need luck or $, not skills.

They have changed the cash economy in the game and it's now impossible to make decent progress without paying and the value for paying is way less, £1.79 for 50 cash = 5 continues in match 3 now £1.79 is 100 cash and a continue is 900 so one continue. I didn't mind spending the odd bit every few days as I enjoyed the game But not spending £2 to continue once. You don't get enough cash for beating match 3 levels I got just 10 cash for beating quite a hard level I think time is up for me.

Township is more than just a game for me. It genuinely feels like home. Every time I play, I feel calm, happy, and comfortable, like I’m stepping into my own little world where everything makes sense. Building my town, taking care of it, and watching it grow gives me so much satisfaction. It’s relaxing, fun, and never boring. No matter how many games I try, Township always has a special place in my heart. It’s a game I can come back to anytime, and I know it will always be my favourite.

Normal gameplay is ok, without invasive ads, but everything is catered towards getting you to buy currency. Events are tied to a match-3 puzzle which is not clearly advertised and not to everyone's taste. These puzzles are not designed to be won, but to torture you into spending money to pass. storage in the main game also is designed to be always short, so to fulfill orders and develop, you need to buy materials to progress. trains also don't bring what materials you need.

False advertisement. Gameplay may be fun for people interested in these sort of games, but it does not match even a little bit what the ads show. Developers should not be allowed to get away with misleading advertisements

It's weird that all of the sudden this game has so many 5 stars. I downloaded the game 2 weeks ago and it was a risk, because there were many many complaints. But yeah... The ad is not faithful to the game, and it has issues... like, if you don't send your airplane packages, you're gonna lose all the items in the boxes (And you WILL spend hours producing those items). You're gonna have to pay to make your life easier. If not, although kinda fun, it ends up being unnecessarily demanding.

Grind, wait, grind, wait - that's literally the entire game. That or spend real money to progress beyond anything slower than a snail's pace. All the negative reviews are true. It's not a very good game. They do the carrot on a string approach with sales, dangling paywalled goodies in front your face. Shameful. Also, it's an always online game. Can't play it offline at all. They want to collect as much user data as possible, by forcing us to be connected to the internet. Also shameful. I'm out.

Good game - but nothing like the ads or pictures. I do really like this game. The graphics are amazing, and there are so many little touches that are so cute (eg. a little character doing an activity). I have had to contact support multiple times, either due to a bug I've found (like chests not appearing, or getting 'stuck' in the fog in the match-3 event area) and although they reply quickly, it's often unhelpful and bot-like responses and then they close the chat - before I can even reply!!

I originally left a 5* review when I first joined jist over 1 year ago. BUT...I now need to change it as the game has become so dreadful. They have made a lot of changes which aren't for the better. The mini games are repetetive. Some levels are impossible to win without spending real cash (which I used to do, but not anymore). They have taken a lot of bonuses away from the game and aren't listening to what players want. There is a fb page where you can check out how unhappy players are!

DON’T download it. This game is a huge scam and has “bugs” that suddenly make you spend your in-game cash on the wrong thing, and you can’t undo it. Also, whenever you finally have enough cash for an upgrade, the game somehow becomes unplayable unless you spend that cash to keep playing… You think the support will help? Keep on dreaming.

The game keeps getting more and more repetitive. There used to be lots of fun mini-games, now they left only the most boring one, the candy-crush. There used to be lots of events. A few month ago it was down to 2, mine and transport magnate. Now it is just the mine. The 'adventures' are all the same. It was ok once or twice, but enough is enough, time for something new. Please bring back diversity in the game, all the various mini-games, events, competitions... Repetition brings boredom.

It's type of enjoyable game, but the other game that is like "candy crush" is so frustrating, the way you need to solve a one round in 10 moves, I'm in level 512 and you only have 22 moves, you need to remove the 64 snow and 19 fruits, but the fruit cannot be remove if you target it in one time, you need to double target the some of it, and it's kinda frustrating for me. I found it hard. I think they will give you a level that are impossible to solve for us to buy a money and use it solve a lvl.
it's a fun game, not to pay to win, I took off a star as of the use of ai art but overall good game

Uses a whole lot of battery power (unsurprising). It's an easy way to waste time and is cute. I would like it if you could turn off ALL notifications; you can turn off *some*, but still get others through that you have no control over. As a personal thing, but not a problem with the app, I hate that I have to bulldoze such beautiful deciduous trees to make car parks, bowling alleys, taxi ranks etc. It wouldn't feel so bad if I was building nicer buildings over the top of the sacrificed woodland!

Slow and boring! Played for a few days to gauge its enjoyment! Once the initial cash and coins are used up, it basically ends up a match 3 game. Waiting hours for an extra life to continue the game which is virtually impossible to win and get to the next level. That is unless you want to spend a fortune to buy cash, lives and other stuff. I got to level 67 but ran out of interest and patience in playing . Would be very concerned if kids used this with the amount of purchases..

When I downloaded this game I really enjoyed playing it, but the more I play the more I have realised it is all about buying the extras 🤑. It's frustrating and expensive. I have loads of these games, but this is by far the worst, it barely gives anything away, it is unrealistic on some levels with the allocated moves. On super hard levels it is only possible to complete if you buy your way out of it, the only way to complete those levels is by buying the extras. Don't waste your money kids!

Used to Love this game, now the Game Sucks. Forced to go in parts of the "additional games" where you have to spend money or do anything to advance in your current farm. Now I get out of any part of the game, it freezes in the mode, without closing down the whole game. That really sucks. Fix the problems before Adding to them. Very Disappointed that this hasn't changed in a few years.

The match-3 game is cheating the player. When the final, decisive move remains, the booster lands on a random tile instead of the one that would have successfully completed the game as it did before. The player can no longer trust Township; the game is tricking them into overspending tcash. It's so obvious now. Furthermore, the match-3 game has become so difficult that even the green level (the easiest) cannot be completed in a single go, as was still possible in the summer of 2025

The game starts off very enticing. But as you start to gain momentum, you realise that for any progress you want to make, they want you to spend money. It takes very long to make any cash if you're not willing to pay. The additional games don't really contribute to the game, they just help you wait, cause the construction and farming times are ridiculous! Won't play for much longer.

I've played this game for a few years and I think it has deteriorated recently. I don't like the way that certain building materials are being restrict. You need hundreds of slabs to build in the zoo or township and yet you get NO slabs after sending many trains.it will take years to complete a building .. You can't even buy any. The mini games are always the same and it's getting boring. It's all about the event and spending green or real cash. The enjoyment has gone out of the game ..

I wouldn't recommend this game. It's fun, initially, but it's really expensive to play. To get anywhere in the game, you need to buy the town dollars, and these are $8.99NZ for 130, which buys very little. For example, 88 buys 11 bricks, and 24 buys one axe. I dont want to spend $9 every time I build a factory 😡 This makes it expensive and frustrating to play.

No Ads. tile puzzle game can be nearly next to impossible, ive literally played the same puzzle for over 45 mins trying to beat it, hoping for the right combo of tiles to drop so i can do the objectives, only to be within 5 moves of beating it. "wanna another 35 moves for 10 game $ ($2.78 real money or hours of game play collecting)?" The town building and farming are mindless fun that you play for a few mins a day due to the in game build times. the rest is just trying to pry $ from my wallet

I have mailed to you on several occasions that I cannot send any invitations to my friends nor can I join any Co-op. My friends who have sent me friends who have sent me requests find that I am in level 9 while now I am in level 37. I cannot see their towns or assist them. Kindly look into the matter. I will change the rating only when my issue is resolved. Don't ask me to remove the game and reinstall it again because I have done that n number of times before and lost my game progress.

Don't play this game It is a good game. But if it crashes, there is no support at all, even for paid customers. It has timed mini games, and paid ticked with expiry dates.. Even then when a problem arises, no one responds.. I was on level 108.. This morning it restarted at level 1.. No response from support through the day. My game crashed this morning. After paying consistently for the golden ticket. No response from support for 4 days now. When we pay time is money. Pathetic support.

Is there any special thing to be done before I can be able to play some mini games?? This is because I updated my game and I'm seeing the notification for the jungle game, but I can't see it in my app to play, same thing with the secret area 551. This same issue happened with last update too. I'm just so tired of having to play only the colour puzzles and because of this I don't play the township game as much as I used to anymore, because I feel everything is just the same, always. It's annoying

Limited engaging levels and opportunities to "do stuff", alongwith odd visual propaganda interspersed that made the game-playing a boring, distasteful experience. Not worth the download. As other reviews have said, emphasis is on getting you to spend tons of money on microtransactions, with not enough versatile game scenarios to keep you engaged.

Playrix, please listen to your players. We want variety! We want fun! We want less match-3 and more of the creative, engaging mini-games that made Township so enjoyable in the first place. Bring back the old mini-games, or at least introduce some new and diverse ones. The current focus on match-3 is driving away long-time players. Please, give us back the fun!"

good at first but then it just reaches a point where for every 2 levels you pass then you're stuck on one level for days. unless you have the budget to keep buying cash to spend on extra moves and power ups there's no point after a certain level. and it's the same for building, you get to a point where you need so much material it takes ages to build complete community buildings

Nice game, really cute graphics, easy to figure things out, helpful tutorial that doesn't feel like a lecture, so yeah, I like it. What's disappointing is that the upgrades feel manipulative. There's no way to upgrade the barn, for instance, without spending real cash, and the in-game money is EXPENSIVE. And there's also no way, that i could find, to tell the game to warn you when you're going to spend "dollars". Too bad. I'd rate it 5 stars if they made it less painful to play.

I began to hate this game. In the Calendar of events, almost all levels are difficult. It is impossible to achieve the goal. Previously, it was easy to reach the goal and collect some money to buy other decorations, but now everything you buy has to be spent on all levels. When you play games, you should enjoy and not be nervous. I'll delete this game.

I've played this game for over 8 years now. There’s one thing i've always felt lacking in the game: the ability to interact with residential and commercial buildings. The name of the game is township, but it's too focused on farming and trade. I wish there was a way to interact with residential and commercial buildings. Maybe we could collect taxes, upgrade houses to accommodate more population, etc. But rn these buildings seem to be just there for decoration and nothing else.

Rediculously long wait times! I hardly ever write reviews but this game has infuriated me so quickly. Long term gamer, I'm not naive, I'm aware of pay walls and/or paying to accelerate building however being hit with build times of 5h and growing times of 30m onky an hour into playing is as stated, rediculous. You can't even just set up and walk away for a few hours as the game is still requiring lots of items with sub 10m wait time. Very poorly designed progression road map.

I enjoy the town building but this game is very frustrating to play. Everything takes so long which would be fine if there weren't constant things happening that have time limits. You can't complete them in time without purchasing game cash. The card collection was impossible. Some 3 block games hard to complete without spending game cash. The game discriminates against those who don't want to keep purchasing bundles and game cash. Level 66. Uninstalled.

This game used to be good,but it's just getting worse.I loved playing in the co-op with my family.The mini games were fun,and there were also new events that were constantly on (most of which tied into the farming aspects of the game).However,over several years of playing Township,its focus has been moved almost entirely from being a farming game and having a once-a-month special event to a pay-to-win tile-matching game. I don't recommend this game and until Township goes back to how it was.

Game used to be fun, then you get sucked in to spend money. Too many super hard (nearly impossible, unless you spend money) match games. No more options to opt out of regatta's. I played regularly, now opted out of teams, ignore regatta's other than once every 10 months or so. Stupid map quests, requiring money to play their 1 out of 4 super hard levels, are just there to play 5 lives once a week. Who cares if you only complete 15% of yhe quests. No fun to be compelled to spend money.

This is the worst game ever. I reached 34th level and it surprisingly took me back to level 1 without any explanation, I contacted their support team and they nonchalantly said they wouldn't do anything to give me back my progress in the game. I started playing again and played to level 24 but yesterday they deleted my progress again and I was stuck at level 1 for a second time, so don't waste your time playing this game!

I downloaded this game mainly for the zoo side of things but I gave up trying to get animals for the zoo as you have to get cards to get the animals why can we not just buy them, it would make it more enjoyable to do that, otherwise I like the game except when there is an event you get pop ups telling you basically buy a golden ticket , I just want a good town/farm/zoo game and this has potential to do that but these things let it down.

Extremely disappointed the Confirm option has been eliminated for spending Township Cash. Any accidental touch can result in spending cash, especially in the "Factories". My setting got changed at some point a few months ago and I ended buying extra boxes. Fixed it and now just discovered the setting that prevented that from happening has been officially removed in the last update. Game play is still fun, but hate that they seem hell bent on coercing players into spending more.

so far the game feels good and fun. I appreciate no ads. I like the town building and the art style. the higher level match 3 stages kill this game. not enough moves to finish them force you to spend premium currency. there is also no conformation check for spending premium currency so you can accidentally spend when you don't want to. I'm rating to because the bad outweighs the good. the building part is fun and no ads is good so I give 2 stars. fix the problems for a better rating

This game was really fun until little glitches started to make it difficult to play. My barn capacity went from 305 to 235 randomly one day but I still had 299 items in it. Couldn't do anything but reverse a whole lot of progress. Screenshotted issue and sent to support who treated me like an idiot with patronising language. essentially told me I didn't understand how to play the game and that it must have been some seasonal thing with the barn. It wasn't. Spent money on that game. Such a waste.

All of a sudden, all my land expansions, buildings, factories, trains, the zoo, and the port have disappeared. I still have my XP, T-cash, coins, progress in the minigames, and my supplies. I still have the rewards for placing the factories and so on, which shows that I actually built those buildings. Now I would have to buy everything again. After several attempts, I still haven’t received any response from the Township support team to solve this issue. Therefore, I am deleting the game.

Fun game, quite addictive. I read the reviews and found out that it's actually a farming game (not puzzles and quizzes). You build your own town and earn money. However, the only downside (and I guess it is with every game now) is that it gets very tricky and frustrating when you don't have enough money or supplies to build your town or unlock other features to boost town population and your level. But otherwise a fun game!

Nothing like the video ads. I installed this game after watching one of the adverts where it shows you managing the farms (a little bit like Sims). But it's nothing like that, it's more like Sim City. Albeit the Sim City element where you build a farm is good, it does get a bit boring after a while and it's not what the ads show. I felt like I downloaded under false pretences.

I like the fact that energy isn't required to move ahead in the game like most other games. It's quite addictive trying to build your town. However, I finding the further along I get, the game crashes quite a bit. Most particularly when I go to collect a reward at the end of the regatta, most recently in the mine game, it crashed every time I tried to collect the qualification rewards to move forward. Reinstalling the game doesn't help. Can't use the mine until the game ends. Very frustrating.

One of the best city simulation game. Has a lot of resources to gather using various ways (farm, mine, etc). Has many source of task (train, plane, etc), can't stuck with limited tasks. Has 'co-op mode' with real players to complete task together or simply help each other on their needs. Has regular different mini games (events). In short, verry attractive and has lots lots lots of variation, hard to get bored easily. Great graphics and animation. Entertaining. Addictive. Love it. Recommend it.

It's a really enjoyable and satisfying game, and I loved it until yesterday, when I had this new update where there are really cool things to check out but when I enter the game, it loads slow and when I click on anything, the game crashes and I'm sent back to my homescreen. I don't know what's the problem with it, can someone pleaseeee solve it?? I love the game so much and I don't want to lose all my progress with an update.

Game is a lot of fun and very engaging...until about level 15. You then need so many building materials to expand your town, and the ones you need never seem to arrive on the train. To move along you have to spend real life money to purchase what you need or just hang around with no opportunity for progression. The mini games to earn money/items also get impossible to finish the level without using real-life money to buy features to help you along. It's too expensive to progress past a point.

I had technical issues with the game. I have been trying to get them to respond since forever. After years of play loss all me progress. I couldn't even get a hi from them in terms of assistance. so I stopped playing. I was in level 130. not about to start from level 1 again. so if you get the game, just know that you are on your own if you ever encounter issues.

I enjoy playing Township — the graphics and city-building elements are great. However, the match-3 levels, especially in events, feel unfairly hard without power-ups. Unfortunately, those power-ups often require real money, and free options are very limited. It feels like the game is pushing players to pay just to progress, which takes away the fun. I hope the developers improve the balance so that free players can also enjoy the game without feeling stuck.

I'm having issues watching ads that drop down in the helicopter that allows you to earn cash and township cash. I have only been getting one ad about 4 times a day when I used to get 3 about every hour, have been reporting but still not fixed. Pls fix this issue asap. I play this game every day but am getting a tad bit annoyed that problem is not fixed yet

fun game! just a few things that need improvement: 1) I don't want to be spending so much real money for township cash. I understand there are other ways of earning, but it's not enough. 2) sizing needs to be improved. some things are disproportionate, and I can't place things where I want them! 3) merging mini game sucks. there should be more/different games. 4) zoo tasks should be different. so much potential for mini games there. 5) STOP MAKING THE GAME A CASH GRAB!!!!!

The problem with this game is the pay to win mechanism. Whenever the hard level shows up on the match-3 game, it is impossible to beat without using powerups and you need to pay for more moves (seriously, I don't think it's my skill issue just bad RNG). Secondly, the waiting time is also very long when you reach a certain level, it is hard plan and set a timer around it, unless you spend all your time on it. The only plus point is it's graphic is nice.

I like the game ! But they should consider making it more fun for the players. Things should not have to take so long just to play, or you should be able to plant whatever you want, I u understand the expansion requirements but once again as you progress in the game it takes longer and longer. I think they should update the game with lower time waiting and also to be able to trade items with friends when ever you wants and make it more hands on play friendly , rather than so much waiting around, and then not being able to do anything with your stuff because your storage is full. Other than that I enjoy the game but it gets annoying with all the requirements and waiting time and restrictions

This game is gradually getting worse. Some settings that were available before are no longer there, and the Match-3 game has become far more frustrating. Another major issue is that even a slight accidental tap instantly deducts T-cash. Previously, there was a confirmation option before spending T-cash, but that setting has been removed. This is extremely frustrating, as I keep losing a lot of T-cash because of it. I’m going to uninstall this game. It’s clearly going downhill. 👎🏻

This game is very addictive. But the thing that will make me lose interest is that as you level up, it takes longer and longer for your crops to grow and your factories to finish making items. By level 23 you will be waiting 1.5 hrs for yogurt, 2 hours for a pizza or potato chips, & 4 hours for wool. Also they make it hard make more money. No ads, but they push you hard to buy more game money. Shorten the wait times & make it easier to earn game money so people will keep playing your game!!!

Been playing this game for years and it seems like more and more is being taken away. the zoo is gone, taking away ways of being able to get the supplies you need to build and upgrade things. I spent a lot of time working on my zoo as others would have too. now in the fashion pass you can't even see the challenges to win stuff off it and I pay for the golden ticket too. this game used to be full of so much fun and in the last 6 months it's just loosing more and more things. it's sad.

Haven't been able to log on for approx 24 hours, apparently I need to check my Internet as can't connect to the server, my Internet is fine ! I can log on to other playrix game I play, it's just this one. So annoyed will lose my consecutive daily log on bonus and start from beginning again. Also can't do my daily tasks on the event obviously 🙄. So any chance you could fix the problem at your end as with no WiFi problems on anything else on my phone it doesn't appear to be my end

Used to be really good but they have made the mini game levels really hard. It becomes infuriating in trying to beat a level when you are given so little moves. It's turned into a money making scam. Customer service are as useful as a hole in the head. Don't bother downloading. You'll waste time building up your town to discover that you can't progress far without spending money. Disgusting. And taking my comments into consideration isn't good enough and pointless as the game will be deleted.

Downloaded it based on an Instagram add, and the element of the game depicted in the ad (traffic puzzles) was not part of the original game. The same is true of "Homescape" which advertised a bear chasing the main character and selecting which tool is best to escape. I'm on level 155, and have yet to move beyond the "Bejeweled" section of the game. I'm not sure when, if ever, I'll actually get to the part of game depicted in the ad. I deleted Township when i saw it wasn't what was advertised.

I really enjoyed playing Township. I even spent some money buying some packages. Unfortunately, I lost my phone. When getting the app again, all my progress was lost, taking me from level 59 to 4. I spent 6 weeks trying to talk with support to recover it. I gave all info possible, even my user code, etc, and I never got an answer. The co-op I was, Minino, was full of super nice people around the world. Wish them the best, and I am going to never ever use playix again. Terrible customer service.

This used to be a really good game with lots of players, not so much now. All they want is more and more cash from you. You can't complete mini games with the available moves and free power ups. You have to spend loads to get through them. Also if your phone screen sleeps halfway through a mini game, you loose where you were. Plus any active power ups such as the power ball are lost having to start all over again and build up 10 levels to win power ball back. Only play if you want to farm.

I have decided to change my rating for township really use to love the game but have started spending way too much money on it. The game is no longer fun the prizes could be better if you bought the golden ticket also why still give people building materials when there are no buildings to build. With this last update I can not even spin the wheel as it is just the outline there. I have been playing fo 5years now and am ready to quit.

I have been playing this game for a few years now and used to enjoy it especially some of the in game challenges. Sadly over the last few months the in game challenges have become harder and in some instances impossible unless you spend lots of money. I am seriously thinking of stopping playing apart from I have spent many hours developing my town.

The last few updates made me quitting although I spent 1h/day, I'm lvl6000+ & always bought golden tickets. I enjoyed it a few months ago, but now they halfed rewards (100$ instead of 200$ for mining), made it more difficult to progress with the golden ticket (keys solely from match 3, while energy collection/ usage does not contribute anymore) & now even the 2x bonus does not apply to produced or collected items anymore. This gave me the last bit to close my club and stop playing.

For 6,5y I am playing this game: the first years because it was fun, nice decorations and so many small games inside the game, some of them related with the core idea of the game ( resources managemente). Every week that in-game was replaced with another. Being in a co-op also had importance. After the wow factor passed it felt ok doing tasks for a co-op. For the last 3y or so, since they introduced the pass and the 3match game that is boring and frustating. Many say it, Suport doesn't care.

after playing for a few weeks, and spending a few dollars here and there, I do have a few suggestions. We should be able to dump or trash things that are in our production queue. if you make a mistake and put in an order, it slows the game. it costs too much to dump an item with money let alone 5 of them. So, if we dump an item we could just lose the material that we put in. that is penalty enough. that's my first suggestion. other than that frustration, to which I may stop playing... I <3

I stopped playing this game in part because it became clear that they were happy to misrepresent the gameplay in ads, and also because I'd reached the point where I needed to pay to continue to play at a reasonable pace and I can't afford to. Would have a higher rating if the ads actually showed what you do in the game (these kind of ads are a pet peeve). Otherwise I found it entertaining.

Now this is truly a 5 stars game. You can play, advance, and have astonishing fun w/o paying a single coin. The community is really friendly. The game is ridiculously addicting. A few points however, the mine should be a separate region like the zoo, a mine in the middle of a town is inadequate. Also there should be something like upgrading houses. Lastly, more mini games are in demand.

Extortion, pure and simple. Boring and very slow moving. TCash and other rewards are constantly reduced (ruler of the mine was 200, now 100 eg) and made harder to achieve, objects cost ridiculous amounts of energy points to remove and take forever to restore. A game that was fun and has been made not fun at all, as progress is slow and game repetitive, mini games ridiculous. All designed with the aim of making you buy cash or energy to have any momentum. Losing a lot of players due to this.

It is kinda fun at start but then you soon realise that you are wasting a tons of amounts of time and effort which shouldn't be there. 30min max should have been okay with me, it's just a game. But then there are stuffs that needs 3 or 4 different items(some of them take 30min~8hrs to make/produce) to convert it into a single product (also takes like 2hr~4hr) which makes you feel like it's gonna take forever, literally. Then there's train shipping, the items you would have to ship is sooo random

I used to love this game but now you barely get decent rewards, it's too complicated to embellish your town because everything costs a fortune and there's not much to build when you progress with the levels. My barn it's filled with materials I can't use and filling the helicopter orders it's a mission for few money. Either you pay for the ticket or you are stuck with the game that has become a match 3 game...but at least in others it's easier to get extra moves, here you pay for everything.

Great game. Fun to play with plenty to do. Would recommend if you enjoy being creative. Edit: really disappointed in the new seasonal event. It's so annoying to do to the point where it's most likely certain you'll have to spend money to get into the top 3, something this game has never before. Think I'll be deleting after this. Very poor guys, very poor.

This is the worst game ever! If you look for having fun and spend your time in a relaxed way...forget about this game. You will end up being angry. The game is built in that manner to spend real money. Every level is a struggle to pass, and even if you win some extra helping tools, you will lose them in the first time playing. They made you feel in need to pay money in order to pass forward. Every single level you feel cuz it is made against you .From me is a big NO-NO. Don't waste your time.

After playing this for around 5 years, I'm now downgrading my review to avoid this game. There is no support because tickets are closed after a time and no one replies. Rewards are not paid out and no one cares. The trains arrive with very little and then require lots of difficult good to produce. In short, this is not a free game unless you are a masochist and enjoy endless frustration. To enjoy the game, you have to pay. There is no point in paying for a game that has almost no development.

Said it before will say it again. Decent game but your puzzle (candy crush like) game mode is ridiculously hard maybe not for all (money spenders) but for the average person. Have been stuck on the latest level now for 5 days. Its impossible (well unless you spend money). Its just another game like every other that encourages you to spend money to complete tasks quicker and progress in events. I highly doubt I will be keeping it much longer.

Has anyone else had an issue with their cash disappearing? I started playing, accrued about 70 cash which mysteriously disappeared. I assumed oh well I must have accidentally spent it somehow, saved up an additional 50, that dropped to 2 whilst I was just flicking between different bits of the town. Seems convenient that it's the one you pay for that is disappearing.
